title: Flow Vibing: every prototype is also a flow
bodyText: A canvas tool I built where the prototype and the flow chart are the same artifact. Five steps through the real interface: HTML screens running as nodes, one toggle between flow and prototype, editing a screen without losing the flow around it, references and craft rules living on the board, and element variants generated from a reference wired in beside them.
whatThisProves: I design the system a tool runs on, not just its screens — and I build it far enough to show the real interface doing the work.
